title: Residual Reward Models: Leveraging Prior Knowledge for Efficient Preference-based Reinforcement Learning in Robotics
abstract: arXiv:2507.00611v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Preference-based Reinforcement Learning (PbRL) provides a promising alternative to heuristic reward design in complex robotic environments. However, PbRL often suffers from poor sample efficiency, requiring extensive and costly human feedback, which limits its real-world applicability. Prior work has proposed learning a reward model from demonstrations and fine-tuning it using preferences. However, when the model is a neural network, transitioning between different loss functions across training phases often leads to unstable optimization and performance degradation. In this paper, we propose a method to effectively leverage prior knowledge with a Residual Reward Model (RRM). An RRM assumes that the true reward of the environment can be split into a sum of two parts: a prior reward and a learned reward. translated_title: 残差奖励模型：利用先验知识实现机器人中高效的基于偏好的强化学习
translated_abstract: 基于偏好的强化学习（PbRL）为复杂机器人环境中启发式奖励设计提供了一种有前景的替代方案。然而，PbRL常常面临样本效率低下的问题，需要大量且昂贵的人类反馈，这限制了其实际应用。先前的工作提出从示范中学习奖励模型，并使用偏好对其进行微调。然而，当模型是神经网络时，在不同训练阶段之间切换损失函数往往会导致优化不稳定和性能下降。在本文中，我们提出了一种利用先验知识有效结合残差奖励模型（RRM）的方法。RRM假设环境的真实奖励可以分为两部分之和：先验奖励和学习奖励。先验奖励是在训练前可获得的项，例如工程启发式“最佳猜测”、语言生成的奖励（文本截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一种残差奖励模型，将环境真实奖励分解为先验奖励和学习奖励之和，以有效利用先验知识，缓解基于偏好的强化学习在机器人应用中因损失函数切换导致的优化不稳定和样本效率低下的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Residual Reward Model that decomposes the true reward into a prior reward plus a learned reward, effectively leveraging prior knowledge to mitigate optimization instability and poor sample efficiency in preference-based reinforcement learning for robotics.
